events.title: Tanker near Hormuz struck a second time; Iran claims three ships hit mines
events.summary: UKMTO said a tanker hit on 16 Nov north of Khasab was struck again on 17 Nov with crew unaccounted for, and Iran claimed three ships hit mines near Hormuz; Brent traded around $92.9 early on 17 Nov.

events.title: China petrochemical futures fall 2-6% on 17 Nov
events.summary: Chinese crude futures fell over 6%; benzene over 4%; propylene, styrene and methanol over 3%; PX and palm oil over 2% on 17 Nov.

events.title: Goldman sees Brent averaging $88 in 2027 on returning surplus
events.summary: Goldman Sachs expects Brent to average $88/bbl in 2027 and fall to $78 by December 2027 as the market returns to surplus (as reported).

analyses.summary: AI interpretation: No new TiO2 price was published since the 17 Nov Mysteel reading (sulphate rutile average 13,351 CNY/t, falling). Off-season inventory build in China and flat concentrate costs keep the bias soft. Weaker crude and energy prices do not change the TiO2 picture materially in the short term.

actions.action: Continue hand-to-mouth buying; no need to cover beyond December.

analyses.summary: AI interpretation: Chinese styrene, benzene and propylene futures fell more than 3% on 17 Nov, following crude lower on surplus expectations, even as tanker attacks near Hormuz continued. The East China spot reference of ~9,600 CNY/t (16 Nov) is likely to ease further unless Middle East supply disruption escalates.

actions.action: Hold off on forward styrene cover; reassess if Hormuz attacks escalate.
Flag two-sided crude risk in Q1 cost budgets.
